svg.title: Dice Witch Circle — fillable paint-by-number page
svg.desc: A ritual circle arranged with correctly differentiated polyhedral dice: d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, d20, and faceted d100. Full-color library preview; opening the SVG changes paintable regions into a numbered worksheet.
